headlines.title: Is Iowa a Battleground Again?
headlines.description: How the Hawkeye State became one of the most closely watched battlegrounds of the midterms

headlines.title: Two dead, others injured after truck drives through Kansas soccer game
headlines.description: An adult and a child have died and nearly a dozen others are injured after a pick-up truck drove through a youth soccer game in Wichita, Kansas, according to police.

headlines.title: President Trump faces backlash over Russia sanctions relief
headlines.description: President Trump was in Kentucky on Saturday, rallying for midterm candidates just weeks before Election Day. The President is facing new criticism, including from some in his party, for ordering sanctions relief for Russia, even as it continues to strike Ukraine. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: Neighbor of Oregon shooter describes “normal” teen, loud arguments
headlines.description: The neighbor of the 16-year-old who officials say carried out a deadly attack at an Oregon elementary school said he seemed like a “normal dude,” and also told our team he heard loud arguments from the apartment. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: ‘The house was toast’: Surf swallows California homes
headlines.description: The worst of El Niño is still months away, but Southern California’s fragile coastline is already being transformed by record-setting king tides and storm surges.

headlines.title: Miley Cyrus Honors Late Godmother Dolly Parton With Emotional Performance
headlines.description: Miley Cyrus performed a passionate rendition of her “Aunt Dolly’s” classic “Jolene” during her performance at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.

headlines.title: Two people, including a child, killed after woman drives through youth soccer game in Kansas
headlines.description: A 6-year-old boy and 35-year-old man were killed, and 10 others were injured, when a woman drove a truck through a youth soccer game at a city sports complex in Wichita, Kansas, Saturday afternoon, police said.

headlines.title: Man fatally shot during dispute at Midtown Manhattan subway station, police say
headlines.description: A man died Saturday after being shot during a dispute at a subway station in Manhattan’s Theater District, according to police.

headlines.title: Man, 71, dies after alligator attack while fishing in Florida, police say
headlines.description: A 71-year-old man died after an alligator attacked him while he was fishing, authorities said on Friday.

headlines.title: Pope Leo discharged from hospital after lung cancer surgery
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV was discharged from the hospital on Saturday after undergoing surgery for lung cancer, with his surgeon saying he could be fully recovered in about 10 days.
